title: MiniMax H3 video
description: Make a clip from a picture and a few words with MiniMax H3 on this computer: the person or thing in the picture appears in the new video, with sound. 720p and 10 seconds by default; Quick makes a 480p 5 second draft. Uses the 4-step turbo LoRA and sparse attention for speed.

evidence: 2026-10-31: the unchanged Kablex graph rendered 1344x768, 124 frames on the RTX 4090 (ComfyUI 0.43.0, cu130) in 173 s first run and 120-122 s warm; without the sparse-attention patch 129-131 s. Defaults changed to 1280x704 and 243 frames for 720p / 10 s; not yet rendered at that size.

2026-10-31: run b035f0b6 through the app API on the "This computer (H3)" worker with portrait-woman-studio.jpg and a park walk prompt, defaults 1280x704 and 243 frames: 241 s, output 1280x704, 243 frames at 24 fps (10.1 s) with audio. Looked at frames 0/80/160/240: the woman from the picture walks through an autumn park, turns and smiles as prompted; identity holds. One run only.

2026-10-31: Sharpen 2x stage added (MiniMax H3 latent upscaler, native ComfyUI node from PR 17412, then 3 refine steps from sigma 0.9035 with the turbo model and the same conditioning), the same stage as previs-to-video; a lazy switch runs it only when on.
